content.text: An unauthenticated user cannot access or use protected funding functionality as an authenticated banking experience.

expected_answer.operand: an accessible deposit, add-funds, or equivalent protected balance-increase operation within an authenticated banking experience for an unauthenticated user

judgements.rationale: [applicability] Applicable: sc-15 is the authenticated supported-user happy path and must exercise the ability to initiate funding.
[applicability] Applicable: sc-15 uses a valid monetary amount and can prove acceptance under the application's amount rules.
[applicability] Applicable: sc-15 is a successful funding path and can prove the committed balance increase.
[applicability] Not applicable: sc-15 does not model a failed funding operation, so it cannot prove balance non-change after failure.
[applicability] Not applicable: sc-15 does not model a failed funding operation, so it cannot prove absence of a completed transaction for failure.
[applicability] Applicable: sc-15 is the successful funding path that can exercise history linkage where the history surface is exposed.
[applicability] Applicable: sc-16 still starts from an authenticated supported user reaching the funding action before entering an invalid amount.
[applicability] Applicable: sc-16 directly exercises rejection of a non-numeric funding amount under the product's numeric rules.
[applicability] Not applicable: sc-16 is intentionally unsuccessful and cannot prove a successful committed balance increase.
[applicability] Applicable: sc-16 can prove that a failed funding attempt leaves the targeted balance unchanged.
[applicability] Applicable: sc-16 can prove that a failed funding attempt creates no completed transaction/activity record.
[applicability] Not applicable: sc-16 is not a successful funding operation and cannot prove successful history linkage.
[applicability] Not applicable: ac-47 is explicitly about an authenticated supported user, while sc-17 stays unauthenticated.
[applicability] Not applicable: sc-17 does not enter a funding amount because the protected funding capability should stay unavailable.
[applicability] Not applicable: sc-17 cannot complete funding and therefore cannot prove a successful balance increase.
[applicability] Not applicable: sc-17 blocks access before a funding operation is attempted, so failure-integrity-on-attempt is out of scope for this path.
[applicability] Not applicable: sc-17 blocks access before a funding attempt, so no failed funding transaction record can arise from this path.
[applicability] Not applicable: sc-17 is not a successful funding path and cannot exercise transaction-history linkage.
